title: Successor step for the degreewise negative Koszul basis coproduct

from.place: The one-factor base case and the successor induction step split from the recursive degreewise basis coproduct.

statement: Assume the degreewise supported basis coproducts for the ordered negative Koszul tensor of r+1 factors. Tensoring with one two-term negative factor and reindexing subsets by adjoining the head index gives the degreewise supported basis coproduct for r+2 factors.

source.place: Tag 0A0E, lemma-derived-completion-koszul, finite free negative Koszul calculation.

proof.text: Apply tensorLeft of the degree-p head term to each tail coproduct supplied by h, using isColimitOfPreserves and Cofan.isColimitMapCoconeEquiv. In degrees p=-1 and p=0 the head factor basis is an isomorphism, so the inverse left unitor followed by that basis tensored with the identity identifies the tensor-unit source with the source of every mapped tail leg.

Reindex a tail subset by Fin.succ, adjoining zero precisely when p=-1. Prove its cardinality, its membership at zero, and recovery of the tail by preimage under Fin.succ. Conversely, every full subset is recovered from its zero-membership and its tail. The support equation n=-|I| becomes n-p=-|tail I|. The recursive definition of ringedNegativeKoszulBasis agrees with the normalized tensor of the head basis and the tail basis followed by the total-tensor inclusion.

For a test cofan, define its desc on each total-tensor summand of head degree -1 or 0 using the mapped tail coproduct desc, preceded on each leg by the inverse source isomorphism. Use zero in all other head degrees, then assemble by HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorDesc. The mapped tail fac identity and subset recovery prove the full fac identity. HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.hom_ext followed by the mapped tail hom_ext and cancellation of the source isomorphism proves uniqueness in the supported degrees; outside them the head term, hence its tensor with the tail, is zero.

lean.statement:
theorem isColimit_ringedNegativeKoszulBasis_step
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) (r : ℕ)
    (b : Fin (r + 2) → (O.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections) (m : ℕ) (n : ℤ)
    (h : ∀ n : ℤ, Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk
      ((ringedNegativeKoszul O (r + 1) (fun i ↦ b i.succ) m).X n)
      (fun I : {I : Finset (Fin (r + 1)) // n = -(I.card : ℤ)} ↦
        ringedNegativeKoszulBasis O (r + 1) (fun i ↦ b i.succ) m I.1 n)))) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk
      ((ringedNegativeKoszul O (r + 2) b m).X n)
      (fun I : {I : Finset (Fin (r + 2)) // n = -(I.card : ℤ)} ↦
        ringedNegativeKoszulBasis O (r + 2) b m I.1 n)))
